name: Atexxo Zone 2 iPhone 14 Pro
statusNote: No longer in Atexxo's current range (October 2026).
summary: The Atexxo Zone 2 iPhone 14 Pro is a standard Apple iPhone 14 Pro converted by Atexxo for hazardous areas, certified for Zone 2 under ATEX. It combines increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ec ic). The phone runs iOS 27. No longer in Atexxo's current range (October 2026).

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ec ic IIC T4 Gc
atex.scope: Unit assessment: each unit is checked by a notified body. No certificate number is published.

certification.protection: Increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ec ic)

safety.conditions: Charge in safe area (wired USB-C or wireless). Each unit spark-tested for intrinsically safe circuits (according to the maker's flyer).

os.name: iOS
os.updates: Security updates for 7+ years (based on previous model support)

specs.display: 6.1-inch OLED; ProMotion; Always-On; Dynamic Island; Ceramic Shield
specs.camera: 48 MP main + 12 MP ultra wide + 12 MP 3x telephoto
specs.batteryLife: Up to 23 hours of video playback
specs.nfc: Yes (Apple Pay + Core NFC tag reading)

throughCase.label: USB-C / Lightning port
throughCase.value: Wired charging via housing (USB-C; Lightning on iPhone 14 models)

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Built in (QR via Camera) / Via app (1D/2D)

capabilities.label: NFC reading
capabilities.value: Built in (Core NFC); through-case use not stated

capabilities.label: Satellite SOS
capabilities.value: Built in on iPhone; not verified through enclosure

strengths: A standard Apple iPhone 14 Pro inside, with the same apps and Apple device management as other iPhones
limitations: No longer in the maker's current range
Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
Certified by ATEX unit assessment; no certificate number is published
